# Reviewed exceptions for TestFixerStores_NoFixerReachesAStoreExceptThroughTheShell
# (fixer_stores_guard_test.go; the pass is tools/fixerstores).
#
# Format, one per line:   kind name # reason
#   store-sink <function>   a function a fixer reaches that calls a FixerStores
#                           accessor on something other than FixerStores
#   dep <Method>            a ServerDeps method, not one of the 15 accessors,
#                           that a fixer reaches through the plugin's captured deps
# The reason is required. An entry the pass no longer reports fails the test
# (delete it), so this file only shrinks. Adding a line is a review decision,
# not a way to make the test pass: a fixer that reads a store through the
# plugin's deps reads HEAD's store, not the one the native shell bound to ctx.

# ---- store sinks: both are bodies shared with an operation, called on a plugin
# ---- built by withFixerStores, whose deps answer the 15 accessors from the shell.
store-sink (*Plugin).repairsGuardTags # called on f.p.withFixerStores(f.p.fixerStores(ctx)) (retired_versions_fixer.go buildRun), so its BookTagReader comes from the shell; the other callers are operations
store-sink (*Plugin).versionGroupPrimaryRepair # called on f.p.withFixerStores(f.p.fixerStores(ctx)) (vgPrimaryFixer.Plan), so its OpsStore and VersionPrimaryStore come from the shell; the operation calls it on the plugin itself

# ---- deps that are not stores
dep RootDir # the configured library root, a string; nothing is read or written through it
dep EnqueueOp # AfterApply follow-ups enqueue another operation by definition id; the queue is not one of FixerStores' accessors
dep InvalidateDedupCache # drops an in-memory cache after series rows changed; reads and writes no store
dep InvalidateSeriesCache # drops an in-memory cache after series rows changed; reads and writes no store
dep RenewScanStandDown # renews the legacy stand-down lease inside versionGroupPrimaryRepair, only when params.Apply is set; Plan passes a dry run, and the shell holds the stand-down through rc.StandDown

# ---- deps that read a store the shell does not hand out. These are real reads
# ---- through the plugin's own deps, not the shell's; they are listed, not
# ---- excused. See seams.d/F5-02.md, "Owner questions", for what moving them costs.
dep BookIDsWithIdentifiers # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: a read-only identifier index lookup; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep BooksWithMetadataSourceHash # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: a read-only book lookup by metadata source hash; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep BooksWithMetadataSourceHashInMemory # versionTwinFixer.readersVia binds it from f.p.deps: the in-memory variant of the hash lookup; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep CachedMetadataCandidates # junkTitleFixer.candidateTitleVia reads one book's metadata candidate cache entry through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestCandidateFetchOutcome # lostCandidatesFixer.Replan reads one book's last candidate fetch outcome through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestCandidateFetchOutcomes # lostCandidatesFixer.Plan reads every book's last candidate fetch outcome through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15
dep LatestReconcileScan # reconcileFixer.Plan reads the latest reconcile scan through f.p.deps; not one of FixerStores' 15

# ---- a service call, not a store
dep RefetchMetadataCandidates # lostCandidatesFixer.Apply runs the provider chain and writes the candidate cache through f.p.deps; no FixerStores accessor or repairs.Writer path covers it. Owner question 1 in seams.d/F5-02.md
